name: Mendham Day Camp
description_short: Borough morning camp from 9 to 12:30 at Borough Park in Mendham for children in kindergarten through grade 6. Each week has a theme, such as water week with a water slide, sports week with visiting local teams, and a closing color wars week.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds once registered. A camper who can't attend because of a failed health screening may get credit for a later week.
notes: 2026 weekly price depended on when you registered: $128 early (April 1 to May 25), $161 regular (May 26 to June 17), $188 in season. Week 2 was prorated for the July 3 holiday ($102 early). The page invites Mendham Borough and Mendham Township families and posts no separate non-resident rate. Groups are by grade and gender, with a counselor ratio of 4 to 1 and never above 6 to 1.
